summary: The diff implements DataView.prototype.setFloat64 in its own file. It keeps each spec step as a comment, defaults littleEndian to false only when the argument is absent (args.len() > 2), and delegates to set_view_value with ElementType::Float64, propagating the abrupt completion with `?`. It returns Ok(Value::Undefined). I found no special-casing, made-up values, swallowed errors, or skipped observable steps. The 14 remaining failures come from the sibling getFloat64 built-in still being unimplemented, which the tests use to verify their results, so they are expected and not a defect of this change. The shared helper set_view_value is not in the diff. The build passing implies it already exists, and I did not review its body, which is outside this diff.
notes_for_next_attempt: No changes needed for this ticket. The remaining failures depend on DataView.prototype.getFloat64 (a sibling ticket). The steps that do the real work (RequireInternalSlot, ToIndex, ToNumber, the detached/out-of-bounds TypeError, the RangeError check, and SetValueInBuffer) live in crate::support::typed_array::set_view_value, which this diff does not touch. Its correctness should be checked under that helper's own ticket.
